content: {"episode_id":"ep-05028","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was medically necessary for this patient, who presented with recurrent palpitations (R00.2) and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9), raising concern for undiagnosed paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.91) as a potential embolic source. The study was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. The findings were needed to guide anticoagulation therapy and rate control management based on the burden of atrial fibrillation detected. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial in light of the documented clinical indication."}
